hints.en: `&mut *p` is the first item, `slice::from_raw_parts_mut(p.add(1), len - 1)` the rest.

tests.code: let mut l = [1, 2, 3]; let (a, b) = first_and_rest(&mut l).unwrap(); *a = 9; b[1] = 8; assert_eq!(l, [9, 2, 8]);
let mut l = [4]; let (a, b) = first_and_rest(&mut l).unwrap(); assert_eq!(*a, 4); assert!(b.is_empty());
